dialogues.speaker: Scattered Letters
dialogues.text: (They appear to be letters that have been sent to the Curatorium of Secrets...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There are letters that require <color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color>'s attention...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: ...Seems like there's another matter for me to attend to.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: What's this letter doing here? Did Jahoda forget to put it away?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: "Please help. I really want to have a kitty like Ashru!"

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: "Lady Nefer, can you tell me where you got him?"

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: The place I found Ashru... I very much doubt you'd want to go there.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Give it a couple of days, and I'll have Jahoda pass this letter on to the Adventurers' Guild — looking for cats is their area of expertise.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (It wouldn't be appropriate for an outsider to read these letters...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Maybe I shouldn't read them...)

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: ...Some customers are in too much of a hurry.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Such a pity... A customer who likes playing games, despite showing no talent for them.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Crying your eyes out while discussing the commission, sobbing, "No price is too much"...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: And then revealing your "price," and having it conveniently be exactly what the commission's worth, not a Mora more or a Mora less...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Making a show of losing control over your emotions, then taking a sudden rational turn when it comes time to pay...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Forget it — the sum has been paid, so there's nothing for it but to follow up. We'll settle everything in a few days time.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Did you find something, Ashru?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow. Meow?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Huh... So, you went outside gallivanting with Jahoda again yesterday. You didn't close the window properly when you got back.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow meow, meow meow meow meow...

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: At least she didn't make a scene this time. It looks like she's starting to learn.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Alright, let's leave the commission in this letter to her.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (There's a letter <color=#FFCC33FF>Jahoda</color> needs to look at...)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Another letter? Ugh, please don't make me rescue another cat again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Just where did I put... where did I put it?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Found it! Phew, thank goodness...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I'd be completely done for if I really lost the commission letter.

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: I need to hurry and take it to Boss Nef now, since it seems like there's still time...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow...?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Oh Ashru, my dear Ashru, come, lend me your claws for a minute. I need to open this letter.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow meow, meow meow meow meow...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: *Sigh* I was just joking. And, speaking of which, it looks like your claws are overdue for a clipping...?

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow! Meow meow meow MEOW!

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Alright, it's decided. I'll do it right now. Stay here while I get the nail clippers.

dialogues.speaker: Ashru
dialogues.text: Meow... Meow!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Read.)

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Someone left a letter here again. I hope this doesn't mean another troublesome case...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: "Seeking to join the Fatui! Do you happen to know any way I could get in? Am ready and willing to pay any..."

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: Ugh, I'm done reading this nonsense! What's with this fool, always pestering us to help him join the Fatui?

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What's so great about the Fatui anyway? Why can't he just live a nice, quiet life... Oh, that's right, I have to write a reply...

dialogues.speaker: Jahoda
dialogues.text: What was it that Boss wrote the other time...? I think it was... "Regrettably, we do not have any expertise in this area and are hence unable to help in this matter."
